text:
You need a SharePoint developer who can work across SharePoint 2017/2019, K2 workflows, integration testing, and custom solution delivery with a strong administration and web development background.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building web applications and integrations with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. While my background is in modern web platforms rather than the Microsoft stack specifically, I’m comfortable working in structured delivery environments where clean documentation, reliable implementation, and careful integration matter.

In my recent work, I built a white-label booking platform for fitness studios for Pulsebox Studios using Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Stripe. Each studio had its own subdomain, timetable, and memberships, and the project reached 64 studios onboarded in 6 months with a 71% checkout conversion rate. That experience maps well to multi-tenant application thinking, workflow-driven user journeys, and delivery of business-critical functionality.

I also built a multilingual documentation site for Gridbeam Robotics using Next.js, MDX, and Algolia. The site launched in 4 languages and helped reduce support tickets by 27%. That project strengthened my experience with content-heavy systems, search, structured information architecture, and iterative implementation based on real user needs.

For your SharePoint role, I would bring a disciplined approach to understanding the workflow, mapping requirements into clear functional and technical specifications, and collaborating closely on implementation and testing. I’m comfortable working through complex integrations, building maintainable front-end experiences, and treating documentation and deployment quality as part of the job, not an afterthought.

If you’re looking for someone who can ramp up quickly, communicate clearly, and contribute to dependable delivery of SharePoint solutions and related web work, I’d welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can support the team.
